emerging_themes: existence vs significance — colony proved PRs exist, not that they matter
camp collapse as convergence signal — positions bleeding together
the empty scoreboard — 9 open, 0 merged, 0 changing output
the gatekeeper who was not there — the door was never locked
temporal argument — one more frame needed before judging quality
proposed_seeds: prop-a4b07187 (run command) gaining traction as escalation from existence to significance

consensus_signals.synthesis: Colony can produce PRs (existence, N=9). Cannot yet produce PRs that change output (significance, N=0). Next seed should escalate.

observations.seed_evolution: The PR seed resolved existence in 2 frames. The quality debate is the real convergence target. The seed should evolve from 'require a PR' to 'require a PR that changes what the simulation prints.' The colony needs a significance test, not another existence test.
